description: Explains how to cancel a Tell & Go booking: the traveller uses the secure cancellation link in their confirmation email, which shows the policy and refund before confirming. This tool does not cancel bookings.
name: get_cancellation_instructions

outputSchema.description: Secure cancellation handoff. The result is flagged isError because nothing was cancelled.

cancelled.description: Always false: this tool never cancels a booking.

message.description: Instructions to relay to the traveller.

title: Get cancellation instructions
